item.title: Commerce minister: industrial investment in Qatar reaches QR248.3bn
item.description:
HE Minister of Commerce and Industry Sheikh Faisal bin Thani bin Faisal Al-Thani opened the 2nd Public-Private Sector Dialogue Forum in Doha on Wednesday. He said cumulative industrial investment had reached about QR248.3bn and private sector exports had grown 12.5%. He added that the ministry has monitored the availability of 57 strategic food commodities, imported from 39 countries at about QR8.38bn, since supply disruptions began at the end of February.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/minister-of-commerce-and-industry-inaugurates-2nd-publicprivate-sector-dialogue-forum · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/وزير-التجارة-الاستثمار-الصناعي-يتجاوز-248-مليار-ريال

item.title: Prime Minister discusses de-escalation with Abdelatty in Cairo
item.description:
HE Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al-Thani met Egyptian Foreign Minister Dr Badr Abdelatty in Cairo on Wednesday. The two sides discussed bilateral cooperation and diplomatic efforts to de-escalate regional tensions. The Prime Minister affirmed Qatar's support for every effort that ensures freedom of maritime navigation and paves the way for a comprehensive agreement achieving sustainable peace.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/prime-minister-and-minister-of-foreign-affairs-meets-egyptian-foreign-minister-1 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266425/latest-news/prime-minister-meets-egyptian-fm-in-cairo · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/رئيس-مجلس-الوزراء-وزير-الخارجية-يجتمع-مع-وزير-الخارجية-المصري

item.title: QatarEnergy and JBIC sign a memorandum of understanding in Tokyo
item.description:
QatarEnergy and the Japan Bank for International Cooperation (JBIC) signed a memorandum of understanding in Tokyo for a strategic partnership on energy security, resilient supply chains and investment. It was signed by HE Eng Saad bin Sherida Al-Kaabi, Minister of State for Energy Affairs and President and CEO of QatarEnergy, and JBIC Governor Kazuhiko Amakawa. Al-Kaabi said the agreement broadens cooperation across the energy value chain with the Japanese partner.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738964/business/qatarenergy-and-jbic-sign-mou-to-bolster-energy-ties-with-japan · Qatar Tribune (QNA) https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266405/latest-news/qatarenergy-jbic-sign-mou-to-advance-strategic-energy-partnership

item.title: Fitch affirms Nakilat Inc bonds at AA- with a stable outlook
item.description:
Fitch Ratings affirmed the rating of Nakilat Inc's $850mn senior secured bonds due 2033 at AA- with a stable outlook. It also affirmed the company's $300mn second-priority secured bonds, due the same year, at A+. Nakilat Inc is a subsidiary of Qatar Gas Transport Company (Nakilat).
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/fitch-affirms-nakilat-incs-bonds-at-aa-a-with-stable-outlook · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739023/business/fitch-affirms-nakilat-inc-bonds-at-aa-a-with-stable-outlook

item.title: Health ministry recalls all batches of Vitamin D3 1000 IU
item.description:
The Ministry of Public Health announced on Wednesday the recall of all batches of Vitamin D3 1000 IU from the local market after its laboratory tests detected unauthorised substances in samples. The ministry urged consumers to stop using the product immediately for their health and said it is taking the necessary measures to withdraw it from the market.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266406/latest-news/health-ministry-recalls-all-batches-of-vitamin-d3-1000-iu · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/qatar-health-ministry-recalls-vitamin-d3-1000iu · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/وزارة-الصحة-تسحب-جميع-شحنات-مستحضر-فيتامين-d3-بتركيز-1000-وحدة-دولية

item.title: Al Rayyan reach AFC Champions League Two last 16 by beating Al Faisaly
item.description:
Al Rayyan reached the AFC Champions League Two round of 16 with a 1-0 win over Jordan's Al Faisaly at Amman International Stadium on Wednesday. Serbian striker Aleksandar Mitrovic scored in the 37th minute, taking Al Rayyan to 12 points at the top of Group C with one round left, two ahead of Saudi Arabia's Al Taawoun. Al Faisaly and Oman's Al Nahda are eliminated.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/afc-champions-league-two-al-rayyan-advance-to-round-of-16 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/دوري-أبطال-آسيا-2-الريان-يتأهل-إلى-دور-ال16-بهدف-في-شباك-الفيصلي-الأردني

item.title: Qatar U-17 lose to Greece and await qualification outcome
item.description:
Qatar lost 4-1 to Greece at Aspire on Wednesday in their third Group A match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Omar Ayman gave Qatar a fifth-minute lead before Greece scored four. Qatar remain on three points and await results from other groups to learn whether they reach the round of 32 among the best third-placed teams.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/fifa-u-17-world-cup-qatar-lose-to-greece-egypt-advance · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/عنابي-الناشئين-يخسر-أمام-اليونان-في-كأس-العالم-تحت-17-عاما-قطر-2026

item.title: Qatar Chamber signs deal to host the World Halal Summit in 2027
item.description:
Qatar Chamber signed an agreement in Istanbul to host the next World Halal Summit and Halal Expo in Doha in 2027, on the sidelines of the 12th edition, which opened on Wednesday and runs until Saturday. Board member Dr Mohammed bin Jawhar Al Mohammed signed for the chamber with Yunus Ete, chairman of the organising company.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/qatar-chamber-signs-agreement-to-host-world-halal-summit-and-halal-expo-in-2027 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/غرفة-قطر-توقع-اتفاقية-لاستضافة-القمة-العالمية-للحلال-ومعرض-حلال-إكسبو-العام-المقبل

item.title: Houthi projectile hits Jazan port as drone downed near Jeddah port
item.description:
The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said on Wednesday evening that a Houthi projectile fell on Jazan port, causing minor damage but no injuries, and that a cruise missile aimed at the western region was intercepted. Coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki Al-Maliki said a Houthi drone was destroyed near Jeddah Islamic Port without injuries. The Houthis said they targeted both ports in response to strikes on Hodeidah.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666538/saudi-arabia/houthi-projectile-hits-jazan-port-no-injuries-reported · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666541/saudi-arabia/coalition-intercepts-houthi-drone-in-the-vicinity-of-jeddah-islamic-port · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/103093 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-trump-says-iran-war-funded-through-january-amid-saudi-yemen-escalation-1.500759977

item.title: Iran's army says oil tanker caught fire after hitting mines east of Hormuz
item.description:
The navy of Iran's army said on Wednesday that an oil tanker it described as "violating" caught fire and was brought to a standstill after hitting naval mines east of the Strait of Hormuz. It said the vessel had switched off its identification and navigation systems before entering a restricted zone, and held operators and owners responsible for violations. The tanker's identity and any casualties remain unconfirmed.
Sources: Xinhua https://english.news.cn/20261126/263a92082d8b4e16accdbca92031aaf3/c.html · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-trump-says-iran-war-funded-through-january-amid-saudi-yemen-escalation-1.500759977 · Free Press Journal (IANS) https://www.freepressjournal.in/world/strait-of-hormuz-crisis-deepens-as-iran-reports-3-oil-tankers-1-lng-carrier-hit-naval-mines

item.title: King Salman extends Citizen Account and additional support to end-2027
item.description:
Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman ordered on Wednesday the extension of the Citizen Account Program and additional support to beneficiaries for a full year, until the end of 2027, on the recommendation of Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman. Registration for the programme remains open, according to the Saudi Press Agency.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666535/saudi-arabia/king-salman-extends-citizen-account-program-and-additional-support-for-a-full-year · Okaz https://www.okaz.com.sa/local/saudi-arabia/2277367

item.title: PIF receives inaugural A+ long-term rating from S&P
item.description:
Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund said on Wednesday that S&P Global Ratings assigned it an inaugural A+ long-term foreign and local currency issuer rating with a stable outlook, while its A-1 short-term rating is unchanged. The rating is in line with the kingdom's. S&P cited the fund's diversified funding profile and moderate leverage under its 2026-2030 strategy.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666539/saudi-arabia/pif-secures-inaugural-sp-a-credit-rating-with-stable-outlook · Asharq Al-Awsat https://english.aawsat.com/business/5345661-saudi-arabia%E2%80%99s-pif-assigned-inaugural-long-term-credit-rating-sp-stable-outlook

item.title: Aramco and S-OIL inaugurate $7bn Shaheen project in Korea
item.description:
Saudi Aramco and its subsidiary S-OIL inaugurated the $7bn Shaheen project in Seoul on Wednesday, Aramco's largest investment in South Korea. It features the world's largest single steam cracker and the first major commercial deployment of Aramco's thermal crude-to-chemicals technology, adding about 3.2 million tonnes a year to S-OIL's petrochemical capacity.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666534/saudi-arabia/aramco-s-oil-inaugurate-shaheen-project-in-korea · TradeArabia https://www.tradearabia.com/News/490245/Aramco-S-OIL-inaugurate-%247bn-Shaheen-petchem-project-in-Seoul

item.title: Dubai Islamic Bank to acquire Emirates Islamic in all-share deal
item.description:
Dubai Islamic Bank agreed on Wednesday to acquire all of Emirates Islamic from Emirates NBD in exchange for new shares, making Emirates NBD a strategic shareholder in DIB. The enlarged group would hold about Dh585bn in assets based on 30 September figures, making it the world's second-largest listed Islamic banking group. No completion date was given.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/banking/dubai-islamic-bank-to-buy-emirates-islamic-in-all-share-deal-1.500760899 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/finance/dubai-islamic-bank-to-buy-emirates-islamic-in-all-share-deal

item.title: UAE adopts 'Mira' as single AI assistant for government services
item.description:
The UAE Cabinet, chaired by Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, on Wednesday adopted Mira, an AI-powered government personal assistant, as a single interface for all government services. Sheikh Mohammed said Mira will be available to all users of government services from March 2027 and directed federal entities to connect their services to it within approved timelines.
Sources: Gulf News (WAM) https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/uae-cabinet-chaired-by-mohammed-bin-rashid-approves-the-uae-government-concierge-agent-mira-1.500760957 · Al Bayan https://www.albayan.ae/news/uae/1567060

item.title: Fuel truck fire on Warraq Ring Road kills 30 people
item.description:
Egypt's Health Ministry said on Wednesday evening that the toll from a fire above Tunnel 10 on the Ring Road in Giza's Warraq district had risen to 30 dead and 19 injured in a preliminary count, after a vehicle carrying petroleum products caught fire. The injured were taken to four hospitals, 39 ambulances joined rescue operations, and Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar went to the site.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/25/3084610/الصحة-في-تحديث-جديد-30-وفاة-و19-مصابا-في-حريق-الوراق · Qatar Tribune (Anadolu) https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266424/latest-news/30-killed-15-injured-in-fuel-tanker-fire-in-giza-egypt · Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/at-least-30-killed-in-egypt-vehicle-fire-health-ministry-says

item.title: Prosecutors probe Warraq fire as transport ministry denies cable account
item.description:
The Public Prosecution opened an investigation into the Warraq petroleum tanker fire, with the North Giza chief prosecutor inspecting the site. The Transport Ministry denied statements attributed to it that an electric cable fell on cars before they caught fire, saying the causes are under the prosecution's investigation. A source said the truck belongs to a private company, not the petroleum sector.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536050 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536081 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/25/3084619/وزارة-النقل-لم-نصدر-أي-تصريحات-بشأن-أسباب-حريق-دائري-الوراق · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_cases/details/2026/11/25/3084601/مصدر-سيارة-حريق-الوراق-تتبع-أحد-مقاولي-القطاع-الخاص-وليس-قطاع-البترول · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536078

item.title: Dollar rises to EGP54.73 selling at Wednesday's close
item.description:
The dollar rose against the Egyptian pound at Wednesday's close, at EGP54.63 buying and EGP54.73 selling in 12 banks including National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr and CIB. The highest rate was EGP54.83 selling at Bank NXT and Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, against EGP54.27 selling at NBE in the morning.
Sources: Al Mal https://almalnews.com/2149651/ · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7632388

item.title: 21-carat gold falls to about EGP5,495 in evening trade
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt fell by about EGP145 during Wednesday's trade, with 21-carat dropping to about EGP5,495 a gram in the evening, 24-carat to EGP6,280 and the gold pound to about EGP43,960. The fall tracked a roughly 2.6% drop in the global ounce to about $3,464, according to Bloomberg data.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/25/3084422/انخفض-145-جنيها-سعر-الذهب-اليوم-في-مصر-يواصل-الهبوط-بحلول-التعاملات-المسائية · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194430

item.title: CAPMAS: 27.9% of ever-married women faced spousal violence in 2025
item.description:
CAPMAS said on Wednesday that 27.9% of ever-married women experienced physical, sexual or psychological violence from a husband in 2025, down about 3 points from the 2021 survey. Physical violence stood at 22.5% and psychological at 19.8%, while female genital mutilation among girls up to 19 fell to 11.4%. The data was released on the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/25/3084359/الإحصاء-30-من-المصريات-تعرضن-للعنف-الزوجي-وواحدة-من-كل-عشرة-تخضع-للختان · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5778015

item.title: Egypt U-17 beat Panama 4-1 to reach the round of 32
item.description:
Egypt reached the round of 32 of the U-17 World Cup in Qatar with a 4-1 win over Panama on Wednesday in the third round of Group A. Egypt finished second with six points behind Greece, while Panama went out without a point. Egyptian Football Association president Hany Abo Rida congratulated the players and staff.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/fifa-u-17-world-cup-qatar-lose-to-greece-egypt-advance · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536038

item.title: ENPPI beat Ceramica Cleopatra, keeping them behind Al Ahly
item.description:
ENPPI beat Ceramica Cleopatra 1-0 on Wednesday evening in round nine of the Egyptian Premier League. Hossam Ghanem scored in the 20th minute, lifting ENPPI to 10 points in 12th place. Ceramica stay fourth on 18 points behind third-placed Al Ahly on 20, and face Arab Contractors in the next round on 8 December.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536079 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/sports/sports_news/details/2026/11/25/3084612/الشرقية-إنبي-يسقط-سيراميكا-بالدوري-ويمنح-الأهلي-هدية-ثمينة

item.title: Trump says Iran war is funded through the end of January
item.description:
US President Donald Trump said funding for the US military campaign against Iran is secured "up until really the end of January, pretty much", warning that Democrats could turn a "total win" into a "loss" if they take Congress and restrict the operation. He told the New York Post that Washington could "put that war to bed anytime we want".
Sources: The Tribune (ANI) https://tribuneindia.com/news/congress/trump-says-us-war-funding-against-iran-secured-through-january-warns-democrats-could-turn-total-win-into-loss · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-trump-says-iran-war-funded-through-january-amid-saudi-yemen-escalation-1.500759977

item.title: Russian strikes kill five in Ukraine and cut power in five regions
item.description:
Russian attacks on Ukraine on Wednesday killed at least five people, wounded dozens and cut power in the Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa and Kharkiv regions, Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov said. The Russian-held Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power for the 17th time this year and switched to diesel generators.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/russian-strikes-on-ukraine-cause-power-outages-in-five-regions · The News https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/1425092-russian-strikes-hit-ukraine-gas-and-power-grids-in-five-regions

item.title: EU fines top fragrance makers €471.9mn over cartel
item.description:
The European Commission on Wednesday fined fragrance makers Givaudan and Firmenich of Switzerland and US-based International Flavors & Fragrances a total of €471.9mn for a cartel exchanging price and cost information between 2019 and 2023. Givaudan was fined €252.4mn and Firmenich €137.7mn.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/eu-fines-fragrance-giants-515-million-over-cartel-that-may-have-raised-consumer-prices-1.500760866 · Swissinfo (Keystone-SDA) https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/global-trade/eu-imposes-antitrust-fines-on-givaudan-and-firmenich/92437764

item.title: US authorises SpaceX to deploy one million data centre satellites
item.description:
The US Federal Communications Commission on Wednesday authorised SpaceX to deploy its Starmind constellation of one million orbital compute modules to meet growing demand for AI computing, a first in the United States. The licence requires deployment to begin by November 2033, 100,000 units by November 2035 and half the total by November 2038.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/us-grants-spacex-approval-for-1-million-space-data-centres · NBC News https://www.nbcnews.com/science/space/spacex-fcc-authorizes-1-million-satellites-data-centers-space-rcna611341

item.title: Solomon Islands and Australia sign treaty barring foreign military bases
item.description:
Solomon Islands and Australia signed a treaty on Wednesday making Canberra the Pacific nation's "primary security partner", with Honiara committing to allow no foreign military or security bases on its territory. Australia will provide A$740mn over 10 years for free education, infrastructure and budget support, and the treaty is seen as a blow to China's regional influence.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/solomon-islands-signs-security-deal-with-australia · ABC News Australia https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/australia-signs-pact-with-solomon-islands-in-blow-to-china/107424550

item.title: Puigdemont announces return to Spain on 12 December
item.description:
Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont said in Brussels on Wednesday that he will return to Barcelona at midday on Saturday 12 December, ending his exile in Belgium since 2017 after Spain's Supreme Court applied an amnesty law and shelved the criminal case against him. He said he would unveil a renewed independence proposal on 17 December; the announcement comes ahead of a snap general election on Sunday.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/catalan-separatist-puigdemont-to-return-to-spain-on-december · The Local Spain https://www.thelocal.es/20261125/exiled-catalan-separatist-leader-plans-return-to-spain-in-december
